name: Non-blocking GPU Isosurface Extraction with Progress
definition: A method for extracting isosurface meshes from molecular orbital/density fields on the GPU that operates asynchronously via a non-blocking job API, allowing the render thread to continue while the mesh is being computed.
summary: This method extracts isosurface meshes on the GPU using a non-blocking API that caps per-frame processing time to prevent render thread stalls.
